name: Dear world
source:
Main character is an ordinary student. One day an incident occurs, and everyday life instantly becomes an extraordinary battle for the fate of the world. The world as we know it is gone.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名普通學生。一天，某起事件突然發生，日常生活瞬間化為一場攸關世界命運的不凡之戰。我們所熟悉的世界已經不復存在。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
